scope: Emberfield independent multilayer cave exploration milestone. It does not claim full RimWorld gameplay, identical cave generation, balancing or original-game runtime verification.

campaign.scope: Direct simulation API, not screen-only play. Fresh site-v2 generator-3 map; read-only authoritative terrain and exploration mask choose a sealed cave and short excavation route. Ordinary commands/ticks create surface storage, excavate ladder shaft, designate unknown rock, open cave, mine finite ore and physically carry it back. No injected map, resources, needs, position, time or RNG. Historic published gen1/gen2 saves test migration. Browser separately repeats the disclosed route with UI controls.

browser.scope: Fresh generator-3 worlds created from regional UI; all mutations use visible controls, map clicks, keyboard and real download/file chooser. Read-only snapshot/project/exportSave/blockAt/ladderAt/exploredAt verify rendering and physical effects. The excavation route comes from the API campaign authoritative terrain inspection; this is not a screen-only discovery claim. No campaign fixture is imported to shortcut digging. Genuine historical saves are imported only for explicit compatibility checks.

developmentDiagnostic.note: The initial development run started while version assertions and controlled terrain fixtures were being updated. Six failures were stale current-save version 35 assertions, a stale default-generator 2 assertion, and treating now-valid generator 3 as invalid. The complete final run uses current version 36, default generator 3, invalid generator 4, and explicit generator 2 only for handcrafted historical geometry fixtures. No failed report was overwritten.

limitations: The route was selected with read-only authoritative terrain inspection; neither API nor browser run is screen-only discovery.
Current caves are enclosed chambers with player-excavated entrances. Natural mouths, underground water, collapse and cave events are not implemented.
Raw saves contain real terrain; the exploration boundary is normal rendering and interaction, not encryption.
Raw development, execution and browser reports are retained locally under test-results; selected summaries and screenshot bytes are committed here.
Pages publication and online checks are recorded separately after this source commit.
